payload.why: authenticating to Stripe as this carrier is the one thing this package is for, and the account-portal carrier mounts only slot::http-client, so the credentials-vault that would otherwise own STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is not present to hold it; the key is read in one function, placed on one outbound Authorization header, and never logged, returned or crossed into the provider-agnostic caller.

payload.name: stripe checkout — start: assemble create-session + call slot::http-client with vault-handle Bearer; return redacted evidence (LIVE path, mirrors read-checkout-session)
payload.description: Generic capability-run flow (http-kind, descriptor_id-configured): read the restricted-key handle from vault (key stripe-restricted-key), assemble the Stripe POST /v1/checkout/sessions request (generic build-stripe-http-request worker mounted by blob_ref, ZERO secret), call slot::http-client with the credential injected as a vault-handle Bearer (the secret never enters source/subprocess/workflow — SP4/7/8/9), and fold the redacted evidence projection. Mirrors action:stripe-payment-provider.read-checkout-session (the proven http-client pattern) keyed on capability:stripe.checkout-session.create; the only delta is the POST body binding. http-client stays a blind transport; Stripe knowledge stays in the request builder (no god package). PREREQUISITES to go live (owner-gated): slot::http-client deployed on this app + the sk_ secret sealed in this app's credentials-vault under stripe-restricted-key + dry-run path deactivated. Replaces the prior dry-run worker path (L030).

payload.name: stripe checkout — read: live GET a checkout session and return redacted evidence
payload.description: Generic capability-run flow (http-kind, descriptor_id-configured): read the restricted-key handle from vault, assemble the Stripe GET request (generic build-stripe-http-request worker mounted by blob_ref), call slot::http-client with the credential injected as a vault-handle Bearer (the secret never enters the workflow), and fold the redacted evidence projection (read-capability-evidence redacts via the policy). Complements the webhook completion path with immediate client-side payment confirmation. Real execution is owner-gated (restricted key in vault).

payload.name: stripe ingest — verify webhook signature (vault sign) and write revenue PaymentEvents
payload.description: Dispatched by the generic /ingest/{connection_id} route for a workflow_verified Stripe webhook connection with input {connection_id, body, raw_body, headers}. Verifies the Stripe-Signature WITHOUT the secret leaving credentials-vault: parse header+build message (compute) -> vault read->handle -> vault sign(hmac_sha256) -> compare expected vs v1 + DATA-map (compute) -> write revenue PaymentEvent records. Fail-closed: a bad signature / unmapped type writes ZERO records. The Stripe signature scheme lives ONLY in the package scripts (L098); the route + vault stay provider-blind.
